rule.description: logonHours: Convert to Login Allowed Time Map form
rule.comment: The Identity Vault Login Allowed Time Map is an octet string holding one bit for each half-hour period in a week. Users can logon when the bit representing the current half-hour is a 1. The Active Directory logonHours works similarly except that there is one bit for each 1 hour period in a week. This rule converts to the Login Allowed Time Map format.
